name: com.ahmer.afzal.utils.crashreporting.ReportActivity
description: AhmerUtils (Ahmer Afzal) opens this activity after an uncaught app error to prepare a crash report with the error, app and device details, and available logs or screenshot. It then opens the system chooser to send the report by email.
disableEffect: The app’s built-in crash-report email flow will not be available.
